svg.title: Chess: game 13, move 21
svg.desc: Game 13 of @tannergolden against GitHub, after 21. Nd6+: knight from e4 to d6. It is GitHub's turn, in check, due by 18 Oct. White: king g1; queen f1; rooks a1 and e3; bishop d2; knight d6; pawns a2, b2, c3, f2, g4 and h2. Black: king c8; queen e5; rooks d3 and d8; bishop c5; knight c6; pawns a7, b7, c4, c7, e6 and h7.
